scope: New dated documentary corpus and local review changes only; no product test rerun or native acceptance

limits: A byte hash verifies the acquired local artifact, not the truth, completeness or continued availability of a remote source.
Tool JSON/text hashes are never treated as original webpage or PDF hashes. Git blob SHA-1 is recomputed only for explicitly decoded blob bytes.
Reference existence and declared unit scope are checked; semantic entailment of all 180 claims is not certified by this validator.
NOT_IDENTIFIED cells have references and scope text checked structurally; wording adequacy still needs source review.
Metadata timestamp occurrences include repeated snapshots and are not independent acquisitions. Content publication/commit dates are not treated as retrieval dates.
Initial frameworks routing queries retain UTC intervals rather than invented exact timestamps; interval bounds are checked against the freeze.
The frameworks collector records two revisions at one mutable TUM PDF URL. This validator verifies retained capture hashes, not remote PDF immutability.
Prior F5 execution is inherited evidence, not new comparative-phase execution, native browser acceptance or VM acceptance.
No network retrieval, collected software execution or human inter-rater reliability assessment is performed.
Full raw source material is read only as needed for byte verification and limited inherited-event metadata; no raw text or credentials are emitted.
